name: Powers of Two
description: You are given n integers a 1 , a 2 , ..., a n . Find the number of pairs of indexes i , j ( i < j ) that a i + a j is a power of 2 (i. e. some integer x exists so that a i + a j = 2 x ).
input_specification: The first line contains the single positive integer n ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 10 5 ) — the number of integers. The second line contains n positive integers a 1 , a 2 , ..., a n ( 1 ≤ a i ≤ 10 9 ).
output_specification: Print the number of pairs of indexes i , j ( i < j ) that a i + a j is a power of 2 .
approach_summary: Build a Segment Tree over the array. Implement point update and associative range query operations in O(log N) time per query.
